==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged, but will not change targets to apply the secondary effect on targets that are blocking.

== Trivia ==
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] resembles the [[Undead Lich]].
* During early development, this skill was called "Brutal Blow"<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20041028212856/http://pc.gamespy.com/pc/guild-wars/560459p1.html</ref>.
